items.title: Just Fucking Use Cloudflare – A satirical guide to the CF stack
items.raw_excerpt:
Inspired by the recent justfuckingusetailwind.com, I built a similar "love letter" to the Cloudflare ecosystem. I find myself reaching for Workers, R2, D1, and KV for almost every project lately, so I wanted to capture that sentiment in a single, slightly over-the-top page. It’s a simple side project, but the stack is: - Vite + TypeScript
- Biome + Ultracite
- Deployed (obviously) on Cloudflare First draft in Claude, the copy was drafted with Grok to get that specific tone, then I used Google's AI Studio to accelerate the build with touch up's in Cursor. Link: https://justfuckingusecloudflare.com Repo: https://github.com/mynameistito/justfuckingusecloudflare Curious to hear everyone's thoughts on the CF stack vs alternatives and more traditional deployments.

items.title: Vibium – Browser automation for AI and humans, by Selenium's creator
items.raw_excerpt:
i started the selenium project 21 years ago. vibium is what i'd build if i started over today with ai agents in mind.
go binary under the hood (handles browser, bidi, mcp) but devs never see it. just npm install vibium. python/java coming.
for claude code: claude mcp add vibium -- npx -y vibium
v1 ships today. ama.

title_i18n.en: Vibium – Browser automation for AI and humans, by Selenium's creator
title_i18n.zh: Vibium——由Selenium创始人打造，面向AI与人类的浏览器自动化工具。
title_i18n.es: Vibium – Automatización del navegador para IA y humanos, por el creador de Selenium.

excerpt_i18n.en:
i started the selenium project 21 years ago. vibium is what i'd build if i started over today with ai agents in mind.
go binary under the hood (handles browser, bidi, mcp) but devs never see it. just npm install vibium. python/java coming.
for claude code: claude mcp add vibium -- npx -y vibium
v1 ships today. ama.
excerpt_i18n.zh:
我21年前启动了Selenium项目。若今日重来，以AI智能体为核心构建的产物便是Vibium。
底层采用Go二进制（处理浏览器、双向通信、模型上下文协议），但开发者无需接触。仅需npm安装Vibium即可。
excerpt_i18n.es:
Comencé el proyecto Selenium hace 21 años. Vibium es lo que construiría si empezara de nuevo hoy con los agentes de IA en mente.
Funciona de forma binaria internamente (gestiona navegador, Bidi, MCP) pero los desarrolladores nunca lo ven. Solo npm install vibium.

items.title: A local-first, reversible PII scrubber for AI workflows
items.raw_excerpt: Hi HN, I’m one of the maintainers of Bridge Anonymization.
